transcript:
alex_support: Hey @irene — saw your message. Can you paste the tiny repro and any logs? thread_ts 3615000000
irene_customer: Getting 404s on chat.create after updating to @redwood/sdk-node 0.24. No changes in our code except npm install. Also noticed a billing spike from retries. Anyone else seeing this?
alex_support: Oof. Can you paste package.json deps, node version, and the request log (headers + response body) with x-request-id? Also does pinning 0.23 help?
irene_customer: Sure — minimal repro below
irene_customer: ```js
// index.js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk-node';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'gpt-redwood-1', input: 'hi' });
```
irene_customer: logs:
irene_customer: "POST /v1/chat.create 404 Not Found \n{ error: { message: 'Route not found', code: 404 } } \nheaders: { 'x-request-id': 'rwd-abc-123', authorization: 'Bearer ****' }"
alex_support: Thanks. That looks like the SDK is calling /v1/chat.create but server is returning route not found. What is the exact SDK package string from package.json and the lockfile if possible?
irene_customer: package.json: "@redwood/sdk-node": "^0.24.0"
irene_customer: node v18.16, npm 9.8
alex_support: @tyler_engineer can you triage? filing ticket now if needed.
tyler_engineer: I can take a look. Quick summary: we shipped an internal rename in the client mapping for the chat surface in 0.24 which switches to the new RPC key "chat.session.create" (server side uses a gateway that maps both keys, but some older proxy layers (and some self-hosted Dedicated customers) only accept the legacy /v1/chat.create path). Looks like @irene is hitting a proxy that doesn't have the new mapping.
tyler_engineer: Short-term options:
- Pin to @redwood/sdk-node@0.23.x (confirmed working)
- Set env var RW_API_COMPAT=legacy to force the old route mapping in 0.24 (we have a hidden compat toggle)
- If you can share the x-request-id I can correlate in logs and flip the gateway mapping for that customer
sam_platform: adding that 0.24 also changed default retry behavior: it currently treats 404 as retriable for 3 attempts (bad default for route-not-found). That explains the billing spike — every client saw 3x requests plus backoffs.
sam_platform: Temporary mitigation: configure the client with retries: 0 or add a rule to not retry 404s.
sam_platform: Example config:
sam_platform: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry: { retries: 0, retryOn: (e) => e.status !== 404 } });
```
irene_customer: I pinned to 0.23 and removed retries and the 404s stopped. Billing usage dropped. Thanks. But we need a proper fix for teams upgrading.
tyler_engineer: I'll do three things now:
1) Open an internal rollback for the route key mapping on hosted immediately (hotfix to accept both keys).
2) Cut a 0.24.1 patch to restore legacy mapping by default and change retry policy to not retry on 4xx.
3) Add migration note in the changelog and release notes and notify support.
tyler_engineer: Can you confirm the request id so I can look them up? x-request-id rwd-abc-123
alex_support: I pushed a support ticket S-2026 with notes and linked the request id. Notifying customer success for billing adjustment because of the retry charge spike.
billing_bot: Automated alert: Customer irene@acme reported anomalous token usage increase. Ticket S-2026 created. Flagged for manual review.
irene_customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you want, I can run a smoke test against the patched gateway.
tyler_engineer: Please hold off until I confirm the gateway toggle. Expecting a rollback in the next ~15-30 minutes. I'll respond with test instructions.
deploybot: Rolling: gateway route-compat toggle -> enabled for customer id acme, rollout 15% -> 50% -> 100% (ETA 12m)
deploybot: status: 15% success
tyler_engineer: Gateway rollback is live for acme. Can you retry the original script (same env) and paste new response headers?
irene_customer: Retried — now 200 OK. Response body looks good. headers x-request-id: rwd-abc-125
irene_customer: We've left sdk pinned to 0.23 for the moment. Please confirm when 0.24.1 is published so we can test upgrade path.
tyler_engineer: Will cut 0.24.1 today. It will: keep new internal names but emit legacy route mapping, and update retry defaults (no retry for 4xx). We'll add a deprecation warning in 0.25 with explicit migration steps.
alex_support: Closing out the immediate support loop. Action items: billing review (CS), cut patch release (ENG), add changelog + migration doc (DEVEX).
irene_customer: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
tyler_engineer: Follow-up: PR #4721 opened for the patch, ETA release within 4 hours. I'll post release notes here when published.
alex_support: Marking thread resolved — reopen if anything else pops up.
